home.title: Overview
home.empty: Your plan, expiry date and remaining data will appear here.
home.unverified: Your email address isn't verified yet. Verify it to purchase a plan.

register.title: Create an account
register.invite_code_hint: Required if this site only accepts invited sign-ups.
register.closed: Registration is closed, or a valid invite code is required.

verify.title: Verify your email
verify.hint: Enter the 6-digit code from the email. It's valid for 15 minutes.
verify.hint_sent: We sent a code to {{email}}. It's valid for 15 minutes.
verify.resent: A new code has been sent. Previous codes no longer work.
verify.already: Your email address is already verified.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.hint: Enter your account email and we'll send you a link to reset your password.
forgot.sent: If {{email}} has an account, a reset link has been sent. It's valid for 30 minutes.

reset.title: Set a new password
reset.done: Your password has been reset and you've been signed out everywhere. Sign in with your new password.
reset.link_invalid: This reset link is invalid or has already been used.

reauth.title: Confirm it's you
reauth.description: This action requires you to verify your identity again.

mfa.title: Two-factor authentication
mfa.description: When signing in, you'll need a code from your authenticator app in addition to your password.
mfa.disable_impact: Signing in will only require your password, and all existing recovery codes will stop working.
mfa.regenerate_impact: Your current 10 recovery codes will stop working immediately. The new codes are shown only once.

enroll.step_scan: Scan the QR code with your authenticator app, or enter the key below manually.
enroll.step_code: Enter the 6-digit code shown in the app to finish.

codes.title: Save your recovery codes
codes.warning: If you can't use your authenticator, sign in with a recovery code. Each code works once. These codes are shown only this once, so copy or download them and keep them somewhere safe.

password.title: Change password
password.description: After changing it, you'll be signed out on other devices.
